mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.keyword, r.category_id, c.name AS category_name, r.tag, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions t WHERE t.user_id = r.user_id AND LOWER(t.merchant) LIKE '%' || LOWER(r.keyword) || '%' AND t.category_id = r.category_id AND t.is_classified = TRUE AND ((r.tag IS NULL AND t.tag IS NULL) OR t.tag = r.tag)) AS applied_count FROM mapping_rules r LEFT JOIN categories c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.id DESC

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.keyword, r.category_id, c.name AS category_name, r.tag, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions t WHERE t.user_id = r.user_id AND LOWER(t.merchant) LIKE '%' || LOWER(r.keyword) || '%' AND t.category_id = r.category_id AND t.is_classified = TRUE AND ((r.tag IS NULL AND t.tag IS NULL) OR t.tag = r.tag)) AS applied_count FROM mapping_rules r LEFT JOIN categories c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mapping_rules (user_id, keyword, keyword_normalized, category_id, tag) VALUES (#{userId}, #{keyword}, LOWER(#{keyword}), #{categoryId}, #{tag})
mapper.update: UPDATE transactions SET category_id = #{categoryId}, tag = #{tag}, is_classified = TRUE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND LOWER(merchant) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND is_classified = FALSE

UPDATE transactions SET category_id = NULL, tag = NULL, is_classified = FALSE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND LOWER(merchant) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND category_id = #{categoryId} AND is_classified = TRUE AND ((#{tag} IS NULL AND tag IS NULL) OR tag = #{tag})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.is_classified = FALSE OR c.name = '미분류' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS newly_classified_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.is_classified = TRUE AND (c.name IS NULL OR c.name <> '미분류') AND t.category_id IS NOT NULL AND t.category_id <> #{categoryId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS override_count FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND LOWER(t.merchant) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%'

SELECT t.id, CAST(t.transaction_date AS VARCHAR) AS transactionDate, t.merchant, t.amount, t.category_id AS current_category_id, c.name AS current_category, CASE WHEN t.is_classified = FALSE OR c.name = '미분류' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS newly_classified, CASE WHEN t.is_classified = TRUE AND (c.name IS NULL OR c.name <> '미분류') AND t.category_id IS NOT NULL AND t.category_id <> #{categoryId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS override_risk FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND LOWER(t.merchant) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' ORDER BY t.transaction_date DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT t.merchant, t.amount FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND (t.is_classified = FALSE OR c.name = '미분류') ORDER BY t.transaction_date DESC, t.id DESC
